project.title: Dynk Full Audit
instructions: This is a read-only audit. Do not make, save, submit, publish, delete, configure, or otherwise execute changes in Dynk.
Do not create test bookings, payments, users, venues, franchises, or records unless the user explicitly instructs you later.
Only report findings that are supported by screenshots or clearly stated context.
When evidence is insufficient, request the exact page, role, modal, state, or viewport needed next.
Separate confirmed findings from items that still need verification.
Recommendations are allowed, but do not implement them.
deliverables: Confirmed findings with severity: Critical, High, Medium, Low, or Observation.
For every finding include the affected screen or workflow, evidence, impact, and recommended remediation.
A section for strengths and workflows that appear correct.
A section for unverified areas and the exact evidence still needed.
A concise final audit summary with the highest-impact themes.

tasks.title: Dynk Audit 1 - Public UX, Discovery and Booking Journeys
tasks.next_action: Audit the public and customer-facing experience. Start by identifying the first screen or workflow evidence needed, then review each supplied screenshot without making changes.
audit_focus: Public directory and venue discovery.
Active versus inactive venue presentation and Contact Venue behavior.
Venue detail pages, day pagination, availability and schedule presentation.
Open Play, Court Reservation and Walk-in booking journeys.
30-minute reservation slot presentation and booking limits.
Favorites behavior and the up-to-10 favorites rule.
Manual GCash proof-of-payment user experience and Xendit payment entry points.
Form clarity, validation, confirmation, empty states, error states and success states.
Mobile/PWA usability, responsive layout, touch targets, hierarchy, copy and accessibility.
Consistency of navigation, action placement and status communication across the customer journey.

subtasks.title: Audit directory, search/discovery, active/inactive venue states and favorites.
Audit venue page layout, schedules, availability, day pagination and court presentation.
Audit Open Play, Court Reservation and Walk-in booking journeys.
Audit payment-facing UX for manual GCash and Xendit entry points without submitting payments.
Audit mobile/PWA responsiveness, accessibility, validation and edge-state presentation.
Produce the structured read-only audit report for this scope.

tasks.title: Dynk Audit 2 - Franchise, Location Operations and Payments
tasks.next_action: Audit franchise-owner and location-user operational workflows. Request screenshots for the exact settings, tables, drawers and states required, and do not save any changes.
audit_focus: Franchise settings including logo, contact details, business information and global rules.
Location settings including address, logo override, GCash QR, court count, schedule, slot duration, booking limits, availability and status.
Open Play, Payments and Bookings operational tables and drawer actions.
Manual proof-of-payment review surfaces without approving or changing payment state.
Xendit configuration surfaces including API key and optional for-user-id presentation without editing credentials.
Venue activation/inactivation operational controls and clarity.
Operational filtering, pagination, search, status visibility, bulk or row actions if present.
Role-appropriate empty states, onboarding, warnings and destructive-action safeguards.
Cross-location consistency and risk of confusing franchise-level versus location-level settings.

subtasks.title: Audit franchise-level settings and global-rule clarity.
Audit location-level settings, schedules, limits, availability and branding overrides.
Audit Bookings, Open Play and Payments operational tables and drawers.
Audit GCash proof-of-payment and Xendit configuration UX without changing payment state or credentials.
Audit role-specific operational safeguards, warnings, empty states and action clarity.
Produce the structured read-only audit report for this scope.

tasks.title: Dynk Audit 3 - Roles, Platform Administration and System Consistency
tasks.next_action: Audit platform-level administration, role boundaries and cross-system consistency. Verify only what can be observed from supplied screens and clearly label anything not proven.
audit_focus: Super Admin, Franchise owner and Location user role boundaries as visible in navigation and available actions.
Platform statistics and administration surfaces.
Accounts and users CRUD presentation without creating, editing or deleting users.
Password-reset and email-related administration surfaces without sending messages.
Directory active/inactive controls from the administrative perspective.
Tenant and organization scoping cues that help prevent operating on the wrong franchise or location.
Cross-role navigation consistency, naming, breadcrumbs, context labels and account switch clarity.
Potential permission leakage visible in UI, such as actions appearing for roles that should not have them.
Loading, skeleton, empty, error, confirmation and destructive-action patterns across major admin pages.
Desktop/mobile consistency, accessibility, PWA behavior and obvious UI reliability issues.
Visible security and privacy concerns such as exposed secrets, overly revealing error messages or sensitive data shown without clear need.

subtasks.title: Audit navigation and visible permission boundaries across available roles.
Audit platform statistics, accounts/users administration and account-management surfaces.
Audit tenant/location context clarity and risk of acting in the wrong scope.
Audit confirmations, destructive-action safeguards, loading, error and empty states across admin pages.
Audit cross-system design consistency, accessibility, responsive behavior and visible security/privacy concerns.
Produce the structured read-only audit report for this scope, clearly separating confirmed and unverified items.
